neighbours.label: the partial-byte token opening a Korean word with a rarer first syllable (앵커, 암살, 애착, 야당, 약속)

short: partial-byte token of rarer Korean syllables
notes: Common Korean also splits into a partial-byte token, but with low activation in the probes (' 공', ' 간' about 0.05, ' 먹' 0.02); ' 약국' gave 0.12 while ' 약속' gave 0.50, so the rule is not simply 'rare syllable'. The pole also fires on Japanese ' サーテ' and French ' ré'.
